name: Johnny Jordaanplein groep (Johnny Jordaan, Tante Leen, Johnny Meijer)

surveyed.source: OSM nodes 1704741755 (Johnny Jordaan), 11913325449 (Tante Leen), 11913325451 (Johnny Meijer); five bronzes, plinths and the bench with its raised letters read from Wikimedia Commons photographs (HJ Mitchell CC BY 4.0, Ceescamel CC0) and the 2016-2020 panoramas (faces blurred); the facing (160 degrees, +-20), plinth sizes and bronze heights are visual estimates; the plaques on the blocks are not legible and are plain plates
